# SwiftMotion

Source: https://github.com/ajagatobby/SwiftMotion

Pinned commit: f8d669e0dbbb6b6e6d111deecece23eb1310ddcb

License: MIT, see LICENSE.

ElasticPillButton press proportions and spring feedback adapted into ElasticPressStyle in LiquidButtonMotion.swift. Native ButtonStyle replaces the custom drag-triggered action; no sound, toggle, or delayed activation. Original demo preserved here.
